configurationFields.label: World Generation
configurationFields.description: Follow [these instructions](https://openworldhelp.fandom.com/wiki/Creating_a_server#Generating_the_world) to generate a world for the server after it is first run

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password for players to join the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Player Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the mod version players will use. Find this in the Open World [discord channel](https://discord.com/channels/992806266109964319/992881103071354890)

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that may connect to the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Enable Whitelist
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows only the usernames listed in Data/Whitelist.json to join the server

configurationFields.label: Enforce Mods
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will be forced to use the mods that have their DLLs in the "Mods enforced" directory. Otherwise, players can join with any mods they like

configurationFields.label: Use Mod Blacklist
configurationFields.description: If enabled, mods that have their DLLs in the "Mods blacklisted" directory cannot be used. This setting is usually used when Enforce Mods is disabled

configurationFields.label: Allow Custom Scenarios
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will be allowed to create custom scenarios when creating their save on the server

configurationFields.label: Backup Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period between automatic backups

configurationFields.label: Enable Extra Console Logging
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server console will include additional logging output for developer or debugging purposes. Not recommended for normal use

configurationFields.label: Server Release Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the [server release version] (https://github.com/D12-Dev/OpenWorld/releases) to install. Empty = latest. Back up configuration and update the server!

configurationFields.label: Dotnet Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the [ASP.NET Core Runtime 3.1 version](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet/3.1) to install. Empty = latest. Update the server after changing this setting

configurationFields.label: Bank Cash Per Tick
configurationFields.description: Sets how much banks make every tick (banks tick every 10 minutes)

configurationFields.label: Maximum Cash In Bank For Tick
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum amount of money that can be in the bank

configurationFields.label: Raid Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of initiating a raid event

configurationFields.label: Infestation Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of triggering an infestation event

configurationFields.label: Mech Cluster Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of spawning a mech cluster

configurationFields.label: Toxic Fallout Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of initiating a toxic fallout event

configurationFields.label: Manhunter Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of triggering a manhunter pack event

configurationFields.label: Wanderer Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of welcoming a wanderer

configurationFields.label: Farm Animals Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of receiving farm animals

configurationFields.label: Ship Chunk Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of sending a ship chunk

configurationFields.label: Give Quest Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of giving a quest

configurationFields.label: Trader Caravan Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of sending a trader caravan

configurationFields.label: Silo Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of building a silo

configurationFields.label: Marketplace Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of establishing a marketplace

configurationFields.label: Production Site Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of setting up a production site

configurationFields.label: Wonder Structure Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of constructing a wonder

configurationFields.label: Bank Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of building a bank

configurationFields.label: Airport Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of constructing an airport

configurationFields.label: Airport Usage Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of using an airport

configurationFields.label: Courier Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of establishing a courier station

configurationFields.label: Courier Usage Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of using a courier service

configurationFields.label: Aid Usage Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of using aid

configurationFields.label: Use Custom Difficulty
configurationFields.description: If enabled, all players will be forced to use the following difficulty settings. Make sure you give a value to every setting, or it will be at 0%

configurationFields.label: Threat Scale
configurationFields.description: Adjusts the size of threats like raids and infestations, and the difficulty of quests

configurationFields.label: Allow Major Threats
configurationFields.description: If set, allows major threats such as raids, infestations, manhunter packs, crashed mechanoid ships and more

configurationFields.label: Allow Quest Threats
configurationFields.description: If set, allows quests to present with violent threats and challenges. Otherwise quests will be non-violent

configurationFields.label: Enable Intro Threats
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the fixed intro threats that appear near game start

configurationFields.label: Allow Predators To Hunt Humans
configurationFields.description: If set, allows wild predators to hunt humans

configurationFields.label: Allow Extreme Weather Incidents
configurationFields.description: If set, allows extreme weather incidents, such as toxic fallout, volcanic winters and flashstorms

configurationFields.label: Harvest Yield Factor
configurationFields.description: Adjusts the amount of materials produced when harvesting plants and crops, including cutting trees

configurationFields.label: Mining Yield Factor
configurationFields.description: Adjusts the amount of materials produced when mining

configurationFields.label: Butchering Yield Factor
configurationFields.description: Adjusts the amount of materials produced when butchering, including meat, leather, and yield from shredding mechanoids

configurationFields.label: Research Speed Factor
configurationFields.description: Adjusts the speed of research

configurationFields.label: Quest Reward Factor
configurationFields.description: Adjusts the value of rewards given for quests. Note that the quest reward value is also automatically scaled to compensate for the threat scale, and so this setting adds an additional multiplier

configurationFields.label: Raid Loot Points Factor
configurationFields.description: Adjusts the value of loot carried by raiders. Note that the raid loot value is also automatically scaled to compensate for the threat scale, and so this setting adds an additional multiplier

configurationFields.label: Trade Price Factor Loss
configurationFields.description: When trading, buy prices are increased by this amount while sell prices are reduced by this amount. Maximum 0.5

configurationFields.label: Maintenance Cost Factor
configurationFields.description: Adjusts the cost of rearming turrets. Minimum 0.01

configurationFields.label: Scaria Rot Chance
configurationFields.description: Sets the probability that a corpse will rot upon death, if the creature has the scaria disease

configurationFields.label: Enemy Death On Downed Chance
configurationFields.description: Adjusts the extra chance that an enemy will immediately die when downed. This affects the chances to take prisoners, and thus colony population growth rates

configurationFields.label: Colonist Mood Offset
configurationFields.description: Sets a permanent mood offset applied to every colonist and prisoner. Colonists have a base mood of 50%

configurationFields.label: Food Poison Chance Factor
configurationFields.description: Adjusts the chance that a person will get food poisoning from eating a potentially-poisoned meal

configurationFields.label: Manhunter Chance On Damage Factor
configurationFields.description: Adjusts the chance that injuring a wild animal will cause it to attack

configurationFields.label: Player Pawn Infection Chance Factor
configurationFields.description: Adjusts the chance that a wound will become infected

configurationFields.label: Disease Interval Factor
configurationFields.description: Adjust the frequency of random disease events

configurationFields.label: Deep Drill Infestation Chance Factor
configurationFields.description: Adjust the chance of triggering an infestation when deep drilling

configurationFields.label: Friendly Fire Chance Factor
configurationFields.description: Adjusts the chance of friendly fire. Only affects direct shots that were going to hit their target

configurationFields.label: Allow Instant Kill Chance
configurationFields.description: Adjusts the chance that a colonist can die instantly due to an attack, with the colonist being downed instead. Only prevents some kinds of instant kills

configurationFields.label: Allow Traps
configurationFields.description: If set, players can build traps like spike traps and IED traps

configurationFields.label: Allow Turrets
configurationFields.description: If set, players can build static turrets like mini-turrets, autocannon turrets, and uranium slug turrets

configurationFields.label: Allow Mortars
configurationFields.description: If set, players can build mortars

configurationFields.label: Adaptation Effect Factor
configurationFields.description: Adjusts how much the adaptation score affects difficulty

configurationFields.label: Adaptation Growth Rate Over Zero
configurationFields.description: Adjusts how fast the adaptation score grows over time

configurationFields.label: Fixed Wealth Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will operate in a wealth-independent progress mode, replacing the wealth factor with a fixed progress curve based on time

deploymentSteps.name: ASP.NET Core Runtime Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $DotnetVersion='{DOTNETVERSION}'; Set-Location -Path '{SERVER_DIR}/'; if (Test-Path 'dotnet/dotnet.exe') { $InstalledVersion = (& dotnet/dotnet.exe --list-runtimes | Where-Object { $_ -like 'Microsoft.AspNetCore.App*' } | Select-Object -First 1).Split()[1] } else { $InstalledVersion = '' }; if ( [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DotnetVersion) ) { $DotnetVersion=(Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/release-metadata/3.1/releases.json).\"latest-runtime\" }; if ($DotnetVersion -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$') { Write-Output \"Invalid ASP.NET Core Runtime version format specified\"; exit 1 } elseif ( $InstalledVersion -eq $DotnetVersion ) { Write-Output \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0 } else { if ( Test-Path dotnet.zip ) { Remove-Item dotnet.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/Runtime/$DotnetVersion/aspnetcore-runtime-$DotnetVersion-win-x64.zip -OutFile dotnet.zip -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output \"Download failed from the Microsoft CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not GSCS. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; Remove-Item -Path 'dotnet/*' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Expand-Archive -Path \"dotnet.zip\" -DestinationPath \"dotnet\" -Force *> $null; if ( Test-Path dotnet.zip ) { Remove-Item dotnet.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; Write-Output \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion downloaded\" }"

deploymentSteps.name: Move Server Files
deploymentSteps.arguments: /C xcopy /E /Y /I win-x64\*  > NUL 2>&1 && rmdir /Q /S win-x64\ > NUL 2>&1
